segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Alright, let's go through the pipeline. We're three weeks out from end of quarter so I want to be sharp about what's actually going to close.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Sounds good, where do we stand against target?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Target's four hundred and eighty thousand in new ARR for the quarter, we're sitting at three ten committed, so we need about a hundred seventy more from what's still open.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: That's from new logos only, right, not expansion?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Right, expansion revenue is tracked separately, this is just new business.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Walk me through the biggest deals still open.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Top one is Fenwick Logistics, forty two thousand annual, they're in final legal review, procurement said end of next week most likely.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Any risk there?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Some, their legal team wants a change to our data processing addendum, nothing crazy, but it's sitting with our legal counsel right now.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: I can ping legal today if that helps move it along.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: That would help, it's been sitting for four days.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Next deal?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Northstar Media, twenty eight thousand annual, they had a great demo two weeks ago but went quiet since. I followed up twice, no response yet.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: How quiet, like ghosting quiet or just slow?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Hard to say, could be internal budget approval taking longer than expected, which happens a lot this time of year.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Do we know who the champion is there? Sometimes a different angle in, like a customer success intro, gets a response when sales outreach doesn't.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Champion is their head of analytics, Diane something, I'd have to check the CRM for her last name.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: If you send me her info I can see if there's a warmer way in, maybe through a case study or something relevant to their industry.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: I'll send that over today.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Third deal?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Vantage Health, this one's smaller, fifteen thousand annual, but it's basically closed, they signed the order form yesterday, just waiting on their finance team to process payment.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: So that one's essentially in the bag.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Yes, I'd call that ninety five percent certain.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Good. What about the BrightLoop expansion conversation, is that in this pipeline or separate?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Separate, that's expansion not new logo, but worth mentioning, it's somewhat at risk given the funnel timeout issues we discussed with them last week.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: I've been tracking that closely since the discovery call. If the funnel fix lands before Black Friday like planned, I think expansion conversation goes fine. If it slips, that's a real risk to renewal even, not just expansion.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Good to keep an eye on. Sarah, anything in early stage worth flagging even if it's not closing this quarter?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Yeah, a company called Greenway Foods came in through a referral last week, mid size grocery chain, looking for exactly the kind of funnel and cohort tooling we do. Early days but promising.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Referral from who?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Actually from Rachel at BrightLoop, small world.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: That's a good sign that BrightLoop is willing to refer us despite the funnel frustration, means the underlying relationship is still solid.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Agreed, I read it that way too.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Let's talk numbers. If Fenwick and Vantage both close, plus committed, that gets us to roughly three sixty seven. Still short of target.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Right, we'd need either Northstar to come through, or something currently in early stage to accelerate.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: What's realistic on Northstar given the silence?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Honestly maybe fifty fifty at this point. If Aisha's warmer outreach idea works, I'd bump that to sixty or sixty five percent.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Okay, let's prioritize that then. Aisha, can you get me Diane's info today so we can move fast?

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Yes, sending it right after this call.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: I'll also loop in our marketing team to see if there's a relevant case study in the media or publishing space we can send along with that outreach.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Good idea. What else is sitting in the pipeline that I haven't asked about?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: There's a handful of smaller deals under ten thousand each, nothing individually material, but combined maybe another twenty thousand if a few of them land.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Let's not lose track of those even if they're small, they add up.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Agreed, I'll keep pushing on those in parallel.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: What does the pipeline look like beyond this quarter, are we building enough for Q1 or is everything front loaded into closing what we already have?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Fair question. Early stage count is actually a bit thin right now, Greenway Foods aside, we've had fewer inbound leads the last two weeks compared to earlier in the quarter.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Any idea why, seasonal or something specific?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Probably a mix, a lot of prospects go quiet around this time of year with budget planning season, but I also think our outbound volume dropped because the team's been heads down closing what's already open.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: That makes sense given how much attention Fenwick and Northstar have needed.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Understandable trade off for this quarter, but let's not let Q1 pipeline dry up completely. What would it take to get outbound volume back up without dropping the ball on what's currently open?

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: If I had another rep or even a part time SDR for outbound specifically, that would free up my time to focus purely on closing. Right now I'm doing both.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Let me think about that, that's a bigger conversation than pipeline review, but I hear you, let's put a pin in it and talk headcount separately next week.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: That works, appreciate you taking it seriously.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: In the meantime, I can help surface expansion opportunities from existing accounts, that's somewhat separate from new logo pipeline but it keeps revenue moving while new logo generation ramps back up.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Good idea, are there any expansion conversations worth flagging right now besides BrightLoop?

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Actually yes, Meridian Analytics upgraded their event volume significantly over the summer, they're probably outgrowing their current tier. I haven't had the pricing conversation with them yet but it's worth raising soon.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: I can help you build that pitch if you want, upgrade conversations usually land better framed around new features they'd unlock rather than just a bigger bill.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: That would help a lot, let's grab time this week.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Great, let's put that on next week's agenda as well so I can see how it's tracking.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Alright, let's recap. Fenwick's blocked on the legal addendum, Aisha's pinging legal today. Northstar needs a warmer outreach angle through Diane, using a case study if we can find one. Vantage is basically closed. Greenway Foods is an early but promising lead from a BrightLoop referral.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: That's right. I'll have an updated forecast for you by Friday.

segments.speaker: Tom Becker
segments.text: Perfect, let's reconvene next week same time.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Sounds good, talk then.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Thanks everyone.

summary.overview:
With three weeks left in the quarter, the team reviewed a $480K new-ARR target against $310K committed. Fenwick Logistics ($42K) is close to closing but blocked on a data processing addendum sitting with legal for four days; Aisha will nudge legal today. Vantage Health ($15K) is effectively closed pending payment processing, while Northstar Media ($28K) has gone quiet after a strong demo, prompting a plan to reach their champion, Diane, through a warmer angle such as a relevant case study.

The team flagged that BrightLoop Retail's expansion conversation (tracked separately from new-logo pipeline) is at risk if the Funnel Builder fix doesn't land before Black Friday. On a more positive note, BrightLoop referred a new early-stage lead, Greenway Foods, seen as a sign the relationship remains solid despite the funnel frustration.

Even with Fenwick and Vantage closing, the team projects landing around $367K, short of target, making Northstar's outreach and a handful of smaller sub-$10K deals important to closing the gap. Tom also flagged thinning Q1 pipeline since outbound has slowed while the team focuses on closing current deals, and will discuss adding outbound capacity separately next week. Aisha will pursue an expansion conversation with Meridian Analytics, who have outgrown their current tier, and Sarah will deliver an updated forecast by Friday.
